s.g: Used to form adjectives from nouns or sometimes other adjectives, often relational (meaning "related to X").
to fart (silently, as opposed to перде́ть (perdétʹ))
to be scared or afraid of something, to panic
to ventilate, to refresh, to take a walk, to go outside
letter of attorney, power of attorney
to put out feelers, to investigate, to ask around
to buy, to buy in, to buy up
to import (to bring in from a foreign country)
Borneo (the world's third-largest island, in Southeast Asia, politically divided between Malaysia, Brunei and Indonesia)
idiot, fool, stupid or naive person
comedown, hangover (the process of recovery of the body after consumption of alcohol and/or drugs)
to make over, to alter (to change the form or structure of)
to toss up, to throw up
to put secretly/stealthily, to plant (fake evidence)
to bring up, to give some more
to add (a card) to be beaten
to slip and fall, to especially on ice
to disgrace, to defame, to dishonor
Shinagawa (one of 23 special wards of Tokyo prefecture, Japan)
participating country (in an international level conference or agreement)
